records.text: Quartz Dynamics canceled -- going to follow up to understand why

records.subject: Your Wrenfield subscription has been canceled
records.body:
Hi Keiko,

Your Wrenfield subscription is canceled. If it was something specific that didn't fit, let us know -- it helps us improve.

Thanks,
Chidi Haddad

records.subject: A quick nudge about your Wrenfield workspace
records.body:
Hi Keiko,

We haven't seen much activity on Quartz Dynamics' account yet. If priorities shifted, no worries -- but if you're still interested, I'm glad to help you get moving.

Thanks,
Chidi Haddad

records.subject: A few days into Wrenfield -- how's it going?
records.body:
Hi Keiko,

Quick note to see how things are going. A lot of teams get stuck at the same step -- inviting teammates -- so if that's where you are, happy to walk through it.

Thanks,
Chidi Haddad

records.subject: Welcome aboard, Quartz Dynamics
records.body:
Hi Keiko,

Welcome to Wrenfield. If you're bringing a team along, a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time, and seats can be added any time from Account Settings.

I'm around if you need anything.

Thanks,
Chidi Haddad

decisions.rationale: Six days in, zero customer replies to three outreach emails (9bcd1c5d, 2d283d14, 7faad802), no-show at the getting started call (calendar:185abc39), no project, no invite, no tickets. No engagement signal at all suggests low chance of self-serve activation in the remaining 8 days.

draft.subject: Your first project in Wrenfield
draft.body:
Hi Keiko,

I know things get busy, so I'll keep this short. In Wrenfield, projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, so creating the first one is usually the step that makes everything else click. The in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project.

If it's easier, I'm happy to hop on a short call this week and set up that first project with you 
dash just reply with a time that suits and I'll work around it.

Best,
Chidi
